HOP-01 evidence restart.question: Do you still see the first-chord-after-a-hop being eaten in daily use?
HOP-01 evidence restart.answer: Not sure — I don't test it. After a hop the author usually reaches for the mouse or waits a beat, so the first chord is rarely exercised at all.
options_presented: Not sure — I don't test it

HOP-01 evidence restart.question: Should Phase 2 run criterion 1's four-modifier test cold against today's code as its first task, before any fix is designed?
HOP-01 evidence restart.answer: Yes, with a not-a-defect exit. All four clean → HOP-01 closes as a recorded finding (HOP-03 precedent). Any failure → deliberate reproduction, fix designed against a real failing case.
options_presented: Yes, but a clean pass isn't conclusive

HOP-01 evidence restart.question: How much modstate work does Phase 2 do, and does it become part of ilhop?
HOP-01 evidence restart.answer: Fix in place, stays out of the repo. Mask before judging, print the masked value, keep it at its current Mac path as a personal diagnostic.
options_presented: Fix in place, stays out of the repo (Recommended)
Fix it and adopt it into the repo

HOP-01 evidence restart.question: If a criterion-1 press fails, what direction does the fix take?
HOP-01 evidence restart.answer: Don't pre-commit — record candidates, let the failure's shape pick. Leading candidate: re-time il-jump:223's UP-flush.
options_presented: Treat it as the upstream hole and document it
